focus: Q2 — generators, mirrors, CI and gate inputs
noveltyJustification: Mapped the four mirror trees to their authored sources and checkers, read both gate surfaces line by line, and pinned the artifact pipeline's determinism and manifestHash coupling.
keyQuestions: Which agents mirrors are generated and from what source?
What do repo-rules-corpus.yml and check-gate-inputs.sh key on?
Can the trigger index and its three fixtures be regenerated byte-identically?
answeredQuestions: authored source is .skilled/agents; claude is parity-enforced mirror + cursor/devin dialect source; pi/codex generated; hermes from SKILL.md + agents
checkers: check-agent-mirror-sync, sync-agents --check, agent-roster-mirror-check, sync-skills-hermes --check; pi check documented but not CI-wired
corpus workflow keys on four path filters + fail-closed .opencode guard; gate-inputs keys on five text rules and strict .opencode/.skilled twin matching
byte-identical regeneration is tested for same corpus; migration edits walked docs so all four artifacts change and must be regenerated together
ruledOut: claude agents as unmanaged copies — parity is enforced and required
hermes mirror covering references/playbook — one SKILL.md per skill only
trigger index walking repo-rules — roots are specs, .skilled/skills, .skilled/hooks

label: Authored agents are .skilled/agents/*.md; .opencode/agents is a symlink to it and both sync generators read .skilled/agents
.claude/agents is a required parity mirror of .skilled/agents and the dialect source for cursor/devin symlinks; no standalone generator writes it
claude/codex/opencode checked by check-agent-mirror-sync; codex by sync-agents --check; hermes by sync-skills-hermes --check; roster by agent-roster-mirror-check; pi check documented but not CI-wired
Regeneration set for the two agent edits: claude/pi/codex x2 plus hermes agent-* x2; sk-doc skill edits additionally ripple to .hermes/skills/{sk-create-repo-rule,sk-doc}/SKILL.md
source: rg -l repo-rules over the four mirror trees

label: repo-rules-corpus.yml keys on four path filters (REPO RULES.md, repo-rules/**, both checker roots) and a fail-closed .opencode guard
gate-inputs filter-twins pairs .skilled/repo-rules/** with .opencode/repo-rules/** in the same paths group; a lone .skilled filter fails
check-gate-inputs.sh enforces five rules (gate-files, hook-inputs, workflow-inputs, filter-twins, parser-miss) with .skilled preferred and .opencode fallback
Trigger-index walk roots are specs, .skilled/skills, .skilled/hooks; runtime mirrors and root README are excluded; repo-rules is not walked
One corpus hash (path+NUL+content+LF) and one manifestHash are embedded across index, manifest, diagnostics and variants; publishJson writes atomically
Byte-identical regeneration on a second run over the same corpus is a tested property; canonical serialization and cross-artifact hash equality are asserted
The trigger-index generator has no --check/dry-run; run publishes or refuses, so drift verification is regenerate-and-diff
Migration edits walked skill docs, so corpus hash/manifestHash change and all four artifacts must be regenerated together even though the phrase inventory is unchanged
